lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in approximately four to five visible horizontal rows extending from the mid-section toward the caudal peduncle, with vertical alignment forming a pseudo-grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like visual structure across the posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is present along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible portion of the left pectoral fin displays a dense cluster of significantly smaller, high-luminance spots compared to the distribution on the lateral flank.
